dialogue.origin: ぼたんさん、こんにちは。本日は宜しくお願い致します。ご準備ができましたらお知らせください。
dialogue.content: Hello, Ms. Botan. Thank you for meeting with me today. Please let me know when you're ready.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。準備完了です。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I'm ready.

dialogue.origin: はい、宜しくお願い致します。では始めさせて頂きます。
dialogue.content: Alright, thank you. Let's begin.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: 今日はご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming to consult with me today.

dialogue.origin: まず初めにあなたの年齢、性別、ご相談の中で何とお呼びしたらよいか教えてください。
dialogue.content: First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like me to call you during our session?

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please go ahead.

dialogue.origin: 50代女性、はな　と呼んで下さい
dialogue.content: I'm a woman in my 50s. Please call me Hana.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。はなさん、今日のご相談はどの様な事でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you, Ms. Hana. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 派遣の仕事をしていますが、その職場で直接雇用にならないかと誘われて悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I work as a temporary staff member, and my workplace has invited me to become a direct employee. I'm torn about what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。なぜ直接雇用を悩まれているか教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Could you tell me why you're hesitant about the direct-hire position?

dialogue.origin: 派遣の方が気軽でいいなと
dialogue.content: I feel that being a temporary employee is more flexible and easygoing.

dialogue.origin: なるほどです。今はどの様なお仕事をされていますか？
dialogue.content: I understand. What kind of work are you doing now?

dialogue.origin: 大学で事務の仕事をしています
dialogue.content: I do administrative work at a university.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 気楽とさきほど教えて頂いたのですが、正社員になると具体的に何が大変になるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned that being a temp is more flexible. What, specifically, do you think would become difficult if you became a full-time employee?

dialogue.origin: 今の仕事はそのままでいいようで、大変というよりは、万が一辞めた場合退職歴がつくのがイヤかなと。
dialogue.content: It seems the job itself would stay the same. It's less about it being difficult and more that, if I were to quit, I don't like the idea of it adding a resignation to my employment record.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね・・・それは悩んでしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: I see... That would certainly make you hesitate.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよね
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: お仕事自体はそのままでの、退職歴がつくかつかないかは、今後に変わってきますよね。
dialogue.content: So while the job itself would remain the same, whether or not you have a resignation on your record could affect your future, right?

dialogue.origin: そうだと思うので上司の誘いをお断りしようかと･･･
dialogue.content: That's what I think, so I'm considering turning down my supervisor's offer...

dialogue.origin: 実は
dialogue.content: Actually...

dialogue.origin: なるほど。うんうん
dialogue.content: I see. Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 一度お断りして、今回2度目のお誘いなんです
dialogue.content: I already turned it down once, and this is the second time they've offered.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね！！以前にもお誘いを受けて断られていたのですね。ちなみに理由を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: Is that so! So you had received an offer before and turned it down. By the way, may I ask the reason?

dialogue.origin: 同じ理由です。この2ヶ月の間に2回目です。
dialogue.content: It was for the same reason. This is the second time in the last two months.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・かなり短期間に2度同じお誘いを受けておられるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see... so you've received the same offer twice in a very short period of time.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 上司の方はよほどはなさんに正社員になってもらいたいようですが、そのお誘いの理由はご存じですか？
dialogue.content: It seems your supervisor really wants you to become a full-time employee. Do you know the reason for the offer?

dialogue.origin: 理由は聞いたことないですね。
dialogue.content: I've never been told the reason.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。そうなんですね。想像ですが、それほどお誘いされるのは、仕事の丁寧さや人柄もあるのかなと感じました。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I see. This is just speculation, but I felt that being invited so persistently might be a reflection of your careful work and your good character.

dialogue.origin: かなり職場でお誘いを受けている状況を教えて頂いたのですが、はなさんは退職歴をつくのに抵抗を感じられているのは、どうしてかよかったらお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.content: You've told me about receiving repeated offers at work. If you're comfortable sharing, could you tell me why you feel resistant to adding another resignation to your record?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、今まで転職を色々してきて、面接の時に履歴書に書かれた職歴について聞かれて説明してもらえるのがするのが面倒に･･･
dialogue.content: Well, I've changed jobs several times, and it's become a hassle to have to explain the work history on my resume during interviews...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それは確かに何度も色々と話すのは面倒ですよね。
dialogue.content: I see, it certainly would be a hassle to have to explain things over and over again.

dialogue.origin: 全ての退職の理由が自分ではないので、
dialogue.content: Because not all of the reasons for leaving were my own decision...

dialogue.origin: はい、そうだったんですね・・それは色々と余計に色々と説明したり聞かれるのは嫌でよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, I see... It must be unpleasant to have to unnecessarily explain and be questioned about various things.

dialogue.origin: そこまでしっかり聞いてくれたらいいですが、退職＝自己都合と取られるので･･･
dialogue.content: It would be fine if they really listened that carefully, but resignation is often assumed to be for personal reasons...

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・勝手に自己都合ととられるのは、嫌ですね。
dialogue.content: I understand... It's unpleasant when it's arbitrarily assumed to be for personal reasons.

dialogue.origin: 退職には会社都合や景気など、いろんな理由がありますものね。
dialogue.content: There are many reasons for leaving a job—company circumstances, the economy, and so on.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 私も以前経営不振で退職した経験があるので、そのお気持ち分かります。
dialogue.content: I also once left a job due to the company's poor business performance, so I understand how you feel.

dialogue.origin: なので、そのあとから履歴書に（会社都合）と退職理由を書くことにしました。今回万一辞めたくなって自己都合で退職しても、その経験があると足踏みしてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: So, after that, I started writing '(due to company circumstances)' as the reason for leaving on my resume. Even if you were to quit this time for your own reasons, having that past experience makes you hesitant, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そーなんです
dialogue.content: That's exactly it.

dialogue.origin: 今の職場は、
dialogue.content: As for my current workplace,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 派遣されてようやく1年なります。
dialogue.content: It's finally been one year since I was sent here as a temp.

dialogue.origin: はい。そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So it's been a year.

dialogue.origin: まだ職場の様子もやっと掴めた感じで不安があります。
dialogue.content: I feel like I've only just now gotten a handle on how the workplace operates, so I still feel uneasy.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうですよね。見えないことが多いと不安になりますよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that makes sense. It's natural to feel uneasy when there are many unknowns.

dialogue.origin: 特にどういったことが一番不安ですか？
dialogue.content: What in particular makes you the most anxious?

dialogue.origin: 社員になると、入試の手伝いとか休日がなくなります。振替はありますが･･･
dialogue.content: If I become a full-time employee, I'll have to help with things like entrance exams, which means losing my days off. There are compensatory days, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん、確かに休日がなくなるのはしんどいし困りますよね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm, losing your days off would indeed be tough and inconvenient.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、派遣だと全くないし定時で上がれるので残業ないです。
dialogue.content: That's right. As a temp, I don't have to do any of that, and I can leave on time, so there's no overtime.

dialogue.origin: ええ、それは体力的にも精神的にも負担が少ないですよね。ちなみにはなさんのご家族構成をおしえていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Yes, that's less of a burden, both physically and mentally. By the way, could you tell me about your family?

dialogue.origin: 両親と姉妹の5人です
dialogue.content: There are five of us in my family: my parents and my sisters.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。休日もご家族との時間もあるのではないかなと思い、お聞きしました。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I asked because I imagined that your days off are also a time for you to spend with your family.

dialogue.origin: 今までぼたんさんの職場や今までのご経歴などお聞きさせて頂きました。
dialogue.content: So far, I've asked about your current workplace and your career history, Ms. Hana.

dialogue.origin: 今までは会社都合の転職をしてこられたけれど、今回もし自分都合で退職がつくことに不安を感じられていること、
dialogue.content: You mentioned that while your past job changes were due to company circumstances, you're anxious that this time, a resignation for personal reasons might be added to your record,

dialogue.origin: 今は残業や休みも確保されているが、正社員になるとそこが見えない不安もあるということをおきかせ頂きました。
dialogue.content: and that while you currently have no overtime and your holidays are guaranteed, you also feel anxious about the uncertainty that would come with becoming a full-time employee.

dialogue.origin: もし正社員になることをお断りしたとしたら、何か仕事で不都合になることはありますか？
dialogue.content: If you were to turn down the full-time position, would there be any negative consequences for you at work?

dialogue.origin: はい、私もそこが心配で上司に聞いたら｢ない｣とのことでした。
dialogue.content: Yes, I was worried about that too, so I asked my supervisor, and they said there wouldn't be any.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！！それはよかったです。
dialogue.content: I see! That's a relief.

dialogue.origin: それでははなさんの気持ちだけを考えて結論を出しても問題ないのですね！
dialogue.content: In that case, it means you can make a decision based solely on your own feelings, without any issues!

dialogue.origin: 今、知り得る情報では、そのような状態かと思います。
dialogue.content: Based on the information I have now, I believe that's the case.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。職場ではなさんの雇用形態に関係なく、はなさん自身を必要とされているのではないでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Perhaps your workplace needs you for who you are, regardless of your employment status.

dialogue.origin: はなさんが迷われているのは、正社員になりたい気持ちもあるということですか？
dialogue.content: Does the fact that you're hesitating mean that there's a part of you that does want to become a full-time employee?

dialogue.origin: 全然ないです。2回も声掛けてくれたので考えないとかな･･･と思ってしまって
dialogue.content: Not at all. It's just that they've asked me twice, so I felt I ought to at least consider it...

dialogue.origin: そうだったですね。確かに何度も短期間で言われると考えてしまいますよね。上司の思いも考えて悩まれるのは、はなさんはとても気遣いのできるかたなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. It's true that being asked repeatedly in a short period of time would make one think. The fact that you're struggling with this while also considering your supervisor's feelings shows that you are a very considerate person, Ms. Hana.

dialogue.origin: 上司の方はそういった点も含めてはなさんにお声かけ下っていたのかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.content: Perhaps your supervisor took those considerate qualities into account as well when they offered you the position.

dialogue.origin: 職場での待遇に変化がないのであれば、はなさん自体のお気持ちを尊重しても良いのでは。。とおもいますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: If there will be no change in how you're treated at work, then perhaps it's okay to respect your own feelings... what do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、上司にはそのままの気持ちを伝えようと思います。
dialogue.content: You're right. I think I'll tell my supervisor exactly how I feel.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね。まずお気持ちや正社員での環境への不安をお伝えしてみるのはとても良いと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, I agree. I think it's a very good idea to start by communicating your feelings and your anxieties about the environment of a full-time employee.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 色々ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for everything.

dialogue.origin: これだけ必要とされるのは、それだけはなさんがお仕事を一所懸命されてきた結果だと感じます。
dialogue.content: I feel that being needed this much is a result of how diligently you've worked, Ms. Hana.

dialogue.origin: ここまで1年頑張ってこられたご自身は素晴らしいことです！！
dialogue.content: The fact that you've worked so hard this past year is a wonderful thing!

dialogue.origin: ここまででお時間になりますが、今日はお話ししたいことは話せましたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: We're coming to the end of our time now. Were you able to talk about everything you wanted to today?

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, I was able to.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。これからのはなさんを応援しております。本日はご相談下さりありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I'll be cheering for you, Ms. Hana. Thank you for your consultation today.

dialogue.origin: ぼたんさん、本日はありがとうございました。これでロールプレイを終了させて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Ms. Botan, thank you very much for today. May we conclude the role-play now?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 本日はこちらこそありがとうございました。これで終了させて頂きます。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well for today. We'll conclude here.

topic.sub: 派遣から正社員への転職不安
